'''Imperial Security''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. They served as [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] on Remnant [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="Vision">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> They also served as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] for the Imperial [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]]. In [[44 ABY]] Imperial Security was led by [[Kthira'shi'ktarloo]].<ref name="Backlash" />

Imperial Security notably helped stop a [[Kidnap attempt in the Galactic Empire Embassy Complex|kidnapping attempt]] of Head of State [[Jagged Fel]] at the [[Galactic Empire Embassy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Additionally, they stopped an [[Operation Duusha|assassination attempt]] on Jagged Fel and the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] while they were dinning at the [[Pangalactus]] restaurant. Imperial Security conducted an investigation into both incidents.<ref name="Backlash" />
